## About
Sport Durst Collision and Cosmetic Center is an I-Car Gold Certified collision center on Durham-Chapel Hill Blvd. Our technicians have gone through a rigorous training program and stay current on repair methods. We measure structure with the Car O Liner vehicle Measuring system and refinish with the BASF water borne paint system.
We make every effort to get the work done in a timely fashion, but we never rush a job to get it out the door. Our technicians take the time needed to make sure the repair is done right. We specialize in Mazda, Hyundai, Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, RAM, Mitsubishi, Toyota/Lexus, Nissan and Honda.
We're rated 4.5 from 309 Google reviews. One reviewer named Natalie, Cameron and YaShone for making the insurance and repair process simple after a run-in with a deer.

## Services
- Major Collision: Repair and restoration after an accident, backed by structural measuring.
- Minor Repairs & Cosmetics: Fixes for minor cosmetic damage so your vehicle looks right again.
- Scratch Removal: Scratches taken out and refinished with the BASF water borne paint system.
- Dent Repair: Dents repaired by I-Car Gold trained technicians.
- Interior detail services: Interior cleaning for your vehicle. Two reviewers mention their car came back detailed after repairs.
- OEM safety calibrations and scanning: Scanning and calibration of vehicle safety systems after a repair.
- Short term storage: Short term storage is available when you need it.
- Air conditioning evacuate/recharge: We're set up to evacuate and recharge air conditioning systems.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all insurance carriers. We are direct repair partners with Progressive, AAA and GEICO, and an open shop provider to insurers including Farm Bureau, Amica, Erie, National General and Allstate. You get to choose who repairs your vehicle.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. You can request a free online photo estimate through our site.

Q: Which makes do you specialize in?
A: We specialize in Mazda, Hyundai, Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, RAM, Mitsubishi, Toyota/Lexus, Nissan and Honda, and we repair other makes and models too.

Q: Can I pay for my repair over time?
A: Our site lists a Repair Now, Pay-Over-Time option. Ask our customer service representatives for details when you call or stop by.
